review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: Some might argue that school should reward students who have the best academic results, while others argue that students who show improvements is needed to reward by school. Personally, I strongly believe that both methods of rewarding offer unique advantages.

On the one hand, rewarding for students who have the best achievement is very important. Initially, students have diligently applied themselves to their studies, they deserve their praises and privileges, this may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards and propel towards overall academic gains. Furthermore, we can see this kind of competition in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. As a result, students are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, so they can achieve success in later life.

On the other hand, students who show improvements is needed to reward by school, this method is also essential. Firstly, only a few smart children can come first and receive the rewards, cause others to think that their effort is futile. Because they can not surpass those outstanding individuals, they prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened and lose the incentive to study. Secondly, emphasizing improvements encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves. This method irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. As a result, the constant desire to outdo themselves, even benefits themselves more than the competitive determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that rewarding for students who have the best achievement and who have improvements, that both methods of rewarding offer unique benefits.
review.overall: Cô thấy em đã triển khai đủ hai hướng của đề và dùng đúng praises and privileges theo dàn ý. Em cần ưu tiên sửa câu dài: xác định chủ ngữ, động từ chính và cách nối kết quả để các ý của em rõ và thuyết phục hơn.
